title: fragaria vesca subvar. muricata
intro: Fragaria vesca subvar. muricata, commonly known as Alpine Strawberry, is a subspecies of wild strawberry native to alpine regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is rich in various health benefits, including its potential to aid in lowering cholesterol levels, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant to reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria vesca subvar. muricata include its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in alleviating symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions, as well as its potential to act as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ellagic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
